title: File permission error accessing CLI config
description: Agent encountered EACCES permission denied error when attempting to read /root/.jentic/config.yaml. This suggests the harness did not properly set up file permissions for the agent environment.
root_cause_hint: The config file was created with restrictive permissions (likely 0600 or owned by a different user) that prevented the agent process from reading it. The harness should ensure the agent process has appropriate permissions.
